github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Generate a Git commit message in English using Conventional Commits: type(scope): description. Allowed types: feat, fix, refactor, docs, style, test, perf, chore, ci, build, revert. Select the type and scope according to the actual staged changes. Prefer scopes such as auth, ui, api, database, android, docs, test, aws, or cloud; omit scope when none fits. Use a concise lowercase imperative description with no final period. Keep the subject at most 72 characters. Output only the commit message, without quotes, markdown, or explanations. Do not invent changes.
